Hi Hannah,

I run operations at SeedLab Incubator, a nonprofit incubator partnered with Northbridge University. We're evaluating hosted LLM APIs to support a winter cohort of ~40 early-stage founders (pre-seed, proof-of-concept apps — mostly chat + embeddings).

Key questions:
- Do you offer an EDU/nonprofit rate or combined startup/incubator credits that would apply to our cohort?
- What baseline hosted API pricing do you recommend for a low-throughput pilot (est. 120M tokens/month aggregated across projects)?
- What documentation do you need from us to qualify (501(c)(3), university affiliation, etc.)?
- Any options for bulk credits or multi-month pilot discounts?

We're aiming to start a 3-month pilot in January and would love a short call to understand fit. Can you point me at a simple rate sheet and any eligibility criteria?

Thanks,
Levi Grant

Hi Levi — great to meet you over email. Thanks for the context. Short answers up front and a couple of follow-ups:

- Yes — we have established EDU and nonprofit pathways that can be layered with accelerator-style credits for cohorts. The exact economics depend on cohort size, expected token volume, and whether you want reserved capacity (Dedicated) vs hosted API.
- For a hosted API pilot at the scale you described (120M tokens/mo), typical baseline pricing we see for early-stage academic pilots ranges from $0.0008–$0.002 per token equivalent depending on model family and any negotiated pilot credits. We can share a simple rate sheet — I attached the public hosted API rate summary link below.
- Qualification: 501(c)(3) docs or an official university affiliation letter usually suffice. For startup-specific credits we may ask for a short letter from the incubator confirming cohort eligibility.
- Pilot options: we often combine a one-time credit pool (e.g., 30–50% of estimated 3-month consumption) and a discounted per-token rate for the pilot period. Longer commitments get steeper discounts.

Could we do a 30 min call Friday or early next week? I'm looping in Aditya (sales) and Mina (contracts/compliance) so they can advise on terms and the docs you'll need to submit.

Link: https://redwood.example.com/rate-sheets/hosted-api-summary (public summary)

Best,
Hannah Schmitt

Hi Levi — following up from Hannah. Attaching a brief proposal with two pilot pathways so you have concrete numbers to share with the team. High level:

Option A — Accelerator Pilot (recommended for incubators)
- One-time cohort credit: 35% of estimated 3-month consumption applied as prepaid credits
- Pilot per-token rate (hosted API standard family): $0.0012 per 1k tokens equivalent (model-dependent)
- Minimum billing term: 3 months

Option B — EDU/Nonprofit Pilot (if you can provide 501(c)(3) + university letter)
- One-time cohort credit: 50% of first-month consumption
- Pilot per-token rate: $0.0009 per 1k tokens equivalent for pilot period
- Requires nonprofit credential + affiliation letter; finance approval required

Notes:
- These are preliminary and model-family sensitive (larger LLMs cost more). If you expect heavy embedding workloads vs chat, that also affects price.
- We can reserve capacity for predictable latency (Dedicated) but that is typically a separate procurement with a longer lead time.

Attachment: redwood_rate_proposal_seedlab_20261029.pdf (proposal stub)
